description: This file defines a Repository class that provides access to various content-related APIs and a local rated store, mainly serving as a stub implementation for development or offline use. It includes stub classes for content retrieval, metadata, assets, and like actions, all returning placeholder data.

classes.name: Repository
classes.description: A repository class providing simplified access to content, metadata, assets, and user ratings using stub implementations.

classes.name: StubContentApi
classes.description: Stub implementation of ContentApi returning placeholder content.

classes.name: StubApaMetadataApi
classes.description: Stub implementation of ApaMetadataApi returning placeholder metadata.

classes.name: StubApaAssetsApi
classes.description: Stub implementation of ApaAssetsApi returning placeholder asset mappings.

classes.name: StubLikesApi
classes.description: Stub implementation of LikesApi returning success based on rating value.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Fetches content for a given ID via the contentApi.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a given content ID.

methods.name: getAssets
methods.description: Retrieves assets (icons, images) for a given content ID.

methods.name: hasUserRated
methods.description: Checks if the user has already rated a particular content ID.

methods.name: sendRating
methods.description: Sends a user rating for content and updates the rated store if successful.
